title: Docs index links to /documentation/cli, /sdk and /worker-nodes, which return 404 (real pages are under /advanced)
description:
**Problem**
https://primus.anth.us/documentation links to /documentation/cli, /documentation/sdk and /documentation/worker-nodes. All return 404. The real pages are /documentation/advanced/cli and /documentation/advanced/sdk (200). The concepts/tasks link is also broken.

**Evidence** (HTTP status on 2026-10-20)
- /documentation/cli 404, /documentation/sdk 404, /documentation/worker-nodes 404
- /documentation/advanced/cli 200, /documentation/advanced/sdk 200

**Fix**
Update the links on the docs index to the /advanced/* paths, fix or remove worker-nodes and concepts/tasks.

**How to verify**
`curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://primus.anth.us/documentation/cli` is no longer linked from the index, and every link on /documentation returns 200.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
